html:
German Samoa was the colony Germany ruled over the western Samoan islands from 1900 to 1914, after the Tripartite Convention split Samoa. Its capital was Apia.

Governor Wilhelm Solf ruled through Samoan chiefs but limited their power. German firms ran large coconut plantations and brought in Chinese and Melanesian labourers. In 1908 the orator chief Lauaki led a protest movement, an early form of the Mau; he was exiled to the Marianas.

When the First World War began, New Zealand troops took Apia without a fight in August 1914. New Zealand then ruled Western Samoa until independence in 1962.
sum: German Samoa was the colony Germany ruled over the western Samoan islands from 1900 to 1914, after the Tripartite Convention split Samoa. Its capital was Apia.
